title: Form and emptiness
subtitle: A short phrase, textual structure and histories of interpretation
shortSummary: Form and emptiness is one of the Heart Sutra's most cited expressions, but it must be read within a specific version, passage structure and Prajnaparamita context.
curatorialDescription: The museum separates concept, passage and version cards so visitors see the wording and locator before entering comparison and interpretation.
Traditions can be placed side by side without treating shared translated words such as emptiness, Dao or ritual as one system of thought.
researchNote: Variant readings, translator attribution, the history of Chinese terminology and scholarship on cross-tradition comparison still need citations.
